title: Google built a portable AI translator that works offline, and you can build one too
summary: Showcasing Gemma's offline, on-device capabilities.
body: TL;DR A team of Google engineers used Gemma 4 E4B running on a Raspberry Pi 5 to build an AI translator that works offline. It comes with a touchscreen display, a push-to-talk button, and a knob to change languages. The code and 3D printing files are available on GitHub, so anyone can build their own AI translator. Google’s Gemma models are quite capable, and if you’ve been wondering exactly how good these models are, there’s something you need to see. A team of Google engineers has created a fully offline translator that uses the Gemma 4 E4B model running on a Raspberry Pi 5. The team used Google Antigravity for development and the Gemma 4 E4B model for the AI chops needed to translate different languages. They also designed a 3D-printed housing to fit all the electronics, complete with a display to show the translated text, a mic, a speaker, a push-to-talk button, and a knob to change languages.

title: Google just extended Gemini Omni’s surprisingly generous free offer
summary: Ten free Gemini Omni videos means ten chances to get wonderfully weird.
body: TL;DR Google has extended free access to Gemini Omni until August 11 at 12 PM PT/3 PM ET, giving users another week to experiment with AI video generation. You can still create up to ten videos for free in the Gemini app or on the web, with no Google AI subscription required. Gemini Omni can generate, edit, and remix videos using text, images, and existing clips, making it useful for everything from social posts to surreal video experiments. AI video generators are getting ridiculously good, but actually playing around with the best ones can often mean running straight into a paywall. Google briefly removed that problem last week by letting anyone try Gemini Omni for free, and apparently, it isn’t ready to close the door just yet. Google originally opened up free access to Gemini Omni on July 30, allowing Gemini users to generate up to ten videos without needing a Google AI subscription. The promotion was supposed to end on August 4 at 12 PM PT, but Google has now extended it until August 11 at 12 PM PT/3 PM ET. More importantly, the allowance hasn’t been reduced. You can still create up to ten videos at no cost, whether you’re using Gemini on the web or through the app.

title: حلم ماريسكا.. مانشستر سيتي يحدد بديل رودري
summary: حدد مانشستر سيتي، البديل المناسب لتعويض الرحيل الوشيك لنجمه رودري، الذي يقترب كثيرًا من تعزيز صفوف برشلونة، هذا الصيف.
body: حدد مانشستر سيتي، البديل المناسب لتعويض الرحيل الوشيك لنجمه رودري، الذي يقترب كثيرًا من تعزيز صفوف برشلونة، هذا الصيف. وأوضح الصحفي المتخصص جيانلوكا دي مارزيو ، عبر موقعه الرسمي، أن المان سيتي يستهدف ضم الأرجنتيني إنزو فيرنانديز، نجم تشيلسي، لخلافة رودري في قلعة الاتحاد. وقال دي مارزيو "نزو ماريسكا مدرب السيتي، يريد فقط ضم إنزو، فقد سبق للثنائي أن عملا معًا في تشيلسي، وهناك انسجام قوي بينهما". وأضاف "إذا كان تقدير ماريسكا للاعب الأرجنتيني، لا جدال فيه، فلا يزال من غير الواضح ما إذا كان من الممكن فتح مفاوضات مع تشيلسي". ونوه أن تشيلسي يعتبر إنزو، لاعبًا محوريًا وجزءًا مهمًا من مشروعه الفني الجديد بقيادة تشابي ألونسو، كما أن تقييم النادي اللندني، لنجمه الأرجنتيني، مرتفع للغاية. وأتم خبير الميركاتو "لا تزال إمكانية إتمام صفقة محتملة مع مانشستر سيتي، بحاجة إلى الاستكشاف، لكن ماريسكا يحلم بضم إنزو". ويبلغ إنزو فيرنانديز، من العمر 25 عامًا، ويرتبط بعقد مع البلوز حتى صيف 2032. . @ManCity , il sogno per il dopo Rodri è Enzo Fernandez https://t.co/iB9Jw58mVn — Gianluca Di Marzio (@DiMarzio) August 6, 2026

title: Ryan Murphy Addresses Ariana Grande’s ‘American Horror Story’ Exit: ‘Who’s Busier Than Ariana Grande? No One’
summary: Murphy reveals he might revisit the scrapped role he had for the star at a later time.
body: Ariana Grande may have missed the opportunity to join American Horror Story this year, but Ryan Murphy isn’t ready to let the idea vanish. summary: Of course, because they predate the ban, the FCC continues to permit their sale.
body: TL;DR A new report details a massive security flaw in Zbtlink-made routers. The routers are programmed to ping a hard-coded list of servers, traced back to China. Once connected, the routers grant full root access — no authentication required. This past spring, the FCC announced a sweeping ban on new foreign-made routers — like the kind you use to get online with your ISP and connect all your devices to Wi-Fi. This was all done in the name of national security, but just how real of a threat do routers pose? The discovery of a new security vulnerability in some Chinese-made routers may have you looking at the FCC’s action in a slightly more sympathetic light. Jacob Baines at VulnCheck shares his analysis of routers made by Zbtlink, sold under both that and Wiflyer branding. While neither are huge names in the router space, they’re still sold through US retailers like Amazon , and have been around for years — so, plenty of time for these devices to make some inroads on the market.

body: الجناح البرازيلي أثار أزمة كبيرة في الساعات الأخيرة فتح نادي الزمالك المصري النار على جناحه البرازيلي خوان بيزيرا، في ظل الأزمة التي ثارت مؤخرًا، بسبب رفض الأخير العودة إلى تدريبات الفريق الأول، قبل بداية الموسم الكروي الجديد 2026-2027. وكان بيزيرا قد نشر، الخميس، بيانًا عبر حسابه الشخصي على موقع "إنستجرام"، أعلن من خلاله رغبته في الرحيل عن النادي خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الحالية، بداعي حصوله على وعد سابق بهذا الأمر. ورد "الفارس الأبيض" على بيان لاعبه ببيان آخر، أعلن من خلاله رفضه لرحيله عن صفوف الفريق خلال الميركاتو الصيفي الجاري، متوعدًا إياه بالعقوبات في حال استمرار انقطاعه عن التدريبات. وقال البيان: "يعلن مجلس إدارة نادي الزمالك برئاسة الكابتن حسين لبيب عن غلق الباب أمام أي عروض لبيع اللاعب البرازيلي خوان بيزيرا، لاعب الفريق الأول لكرة القدم، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الحالية". وأضاف: "ويشدد المجلس على أن النادي حسم موقفه، ولن يناقش أي عروض تصل للاعب، والزمالك لا يمكن إجباره على البيع سواء للاعب بيزيرا أو غيره، خاصة إذا كان اللاعب منقطعًا عن التدريبات". وأردف: "ويشدد مجلس الإدارة على أن بيان اللاعب تضمن كلامًا حول وعده من النادي بالرحيل بنهاية الموسم، وهذا لم يحدث نهائيًا من جانب رئيس النادي أو أي من أعضاء المجلس، وكان على اللاعب أن يحدد من قدم له هذا الوعد". واستطرد: "…

title: Google’s making it easier to get to Gemini from Chrome on Android
summary: Look, it's Gemini again.
body: TL;DR Chrome on Android is testing a new toolbar that provides quick access to Gemini. The new toolbar is rolling out to some users now. Google’s testing another way to remind you that Gemini exists. New controls are appearing in the Chrome browser on Android, adding a button to call up Google’s AI right within thumb’s reach. As reported by 9to5Google , some users (including 9to5′ s Ben Schoon) have started receiving an update to Chrome that introduces a second strip of buttons to the browser UI. By default, this version of Chrome has a URL field, as well as a back button, share button, and and menu button, at the top of the screen, plus a second bar with a Gemini icon and tab controls at the bottom. Tapping the Gemini icon opens a conversation with Google’s AI chatbot.

title: Stop jumping between Adobe apps with this new ChatGPT plugin
summary: Adobe’s entire creative suite is now in ChatGPT.
body: TL;DR After bringing Photoshop, Express, and Acrobat to ChatGPT, Adobe is now launching a unified plugin that brings more than 70 tools under one roof. Users can perform multiple actions, including photo editing, video creation, and more with a single prompt. The new plugin is rolling out globally. It is only available on the web and the desktop app for now. As AI tools become more prevalent, traditional ways of doing things are slowly fading away. You used to perform a Google search for general queries, but now you ask ChatGPT for the same information. Similarly, instead of browsing through multiple websites to plan a trip, you simply ask Gemini to take the reins. AI is clearly changing the way people interact with software and devices, and the latest example of this shift comes in the form of a new Adobe plugin for ChatGPT. For reference, this isn’t Adobe making its ChatGPT debut. The software-maker made Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Express, and Adobe Acrobat accessible within ChatGPT back in December last year. Today’s update significantly expands on that integration.

title: Reddit is letting AI decide when your post breaks the rules
summary: The machines are moving into the mod queue, and they can be given the power to delete your posts.
body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses AI to judge whether posts and comments violate the “intent” of subreddit rules. Moderators decide whether suspected violations are flagged for review or removed automatically. The optional tool is rolling out more widely later in 2026, following testing in over 700 communities. Reddit moderation has never exactly been a polished operation. It runs on volunteer moderators, user reports, and Automod rules that may have been written years ago by someone who has since vanished from the subreddit. Perhaps inevitably, AI is now also being invited behind the scenes at Reddit, with a new system that can decide whether posts and comments should be reported or removed. As The Verge reports, Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses large language models to judge whether content matches the “intent” of a subreddit rule. Automod usually looks for specific words, phrases, or patterns, while the new system is meant to understand context and handle messier cases that don’t fit neatly into a keyword filter.

The results published Wednesday in Nature . This artist’s concept depicts magnetar 1E 1547.0-5408, a rapidly rotating neutron star with magnetic fields over a trillion times stronger than Earth’s. Blue curves emanating from the star’s two magnetic poles represent the magnetic field lines. The magnetar is a significant emitter of radio and X-ray radiation, with their peaks offset during its 2.1-second rotation period. This indicates the primary X-ray emitter is a secondary “hot spot” offset from the magnetic axis. These emitters are depicted as conical sections: the lighter blue radio emission peaks at the magnetic field’s symmetry axis, while the darker blue X-ray emission peaks below. The upper and lower emission cones show X-ray polarization degrees of 40% and 80%, respectively. title: Apple’s Private Relay isn’t always hiding your IP address, researchers say
summary: A flaw in WebKit leaks real IP addresses, and Apple is already looking into it.
body: TL;DR Researchers found multiple issues that can expose a user’s real IP despite Private Relay. The problem is tied to passkey-related requests that bypass Safari’s Private Relay path. Apple has acknowledged the report and says it’s investigating. Passkeys were supposed to fix our login headaches, but as we recently saw with Google Password Manager , transitioning to passwordless security can expose unexpected cracks in your privacy. Now, Apple is facing similar scrutiny after researchers uncovered a WebKit flaw that lets websites bypass iCloud Private Relay and expose users’ real IP addresses during passkey requests. Discovered by security researchers Tommy Mysk and Talal Haj Bakry, the vulnerability centers on how WebAuthn requests interact with iOS (via 404 Media ). When a site prompts for a passkey or even pretends to support one, the network request isn’t processed inside Safari’s standard web browser stack. Instead, Apple’s system-level credential service steps in to handle the fetch directly.
